name: permission-studio
description: View and edit Salesforce permission sets, permission set groups and profiles for your project's default org, right inside VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Permission Studio runs the Salesforce CLI and talks to your org.

permStudio.sf.path.description: Path to the Salesforce CLI executable.

permStudio.project.path.description: Folder of the Salesforce project to use. Leave empty to use the workspace folder that contains sfdx-project.json.

permStudio.apiVersion.description: API version for org queries, e.g. 62.0. Leave empty to use the version the CLI reports for the org.

enumDescriptions: Use the Salesforce CLI's own connection library inside VS Code; if it can't be loaded, call the REST API directly; if that is refused or blocked, run sf for each call.
Always use the Salesforce CLI's connection library (same session, proxy and network route as the CLI). Errors are shown instead of switching.
Always call the REST API directly with the CLI's session. Errors are shown instead of switching.
Always run sf for each call. Slowest; uses the CLI's session, proxy and certificate settings.
permStudio.connection.mode.description: How Permission Studio reaches the org.

permStudio.cache.enabled.description: Keep a copy of what was read from the org so screens open instantly, then refresh it in the background. Stored in the extension's own storage, never in the project.

permStudio.favorites.items.markdownDescription: Permission sets, groups and profiles to load first and keep at the top of the list, as `permissionSet:<API name>`, `group:<API name>` or `profile:<profile name>`. Also set by the star next to each item.

permStudio.favorites.objects.markdownDescription: Objects to show first in Object Settings and to prefetch when an item opens, as API names such as `Lead` or `Invoice__c`. Also set by the star next to each object.

enumDescriptions: Offer it in the review dialog, ticked, whenever the item has a source file in the project.
Always update the source file after a save.
permStudio.localFile.update.description: After saving to the org, also update the permission set or profile file in the project (force-app) so the change can be committed.

permStudio.lists.show.markdownDescription: Which lists to show and load: `permissionSet`, `group`, `profile`. Leaving a list out also skips loading it, which makes start-up faster.

permStudio.autoRefresh.enabled.description: Refresh from the org in the background while VS Code has focus.

permStudio.autoRefresh.minutes.description: Minutes between background refreshes (1 to 30). Lists are only re-read when something in the org changed.

permStudio.sf.installPath.markdownDescription: Folder where the Salesforce CLI is installed, the one containing `node_modules/@salesforce/core` (for example `%LOCALAPPDATA%\sf\client\2.x.y` or `C:\Program Files\sf\client`). Leave empty to find it automatically.
